Get started
Get started

Welcome to Plaeta.

Pick the plan that fits how many past papers you work through each month. You can change it at any time.

Every plan includes every feature: Varda's marking for every question (with fair-use limits on essay marking), all your subjects, syllabus tick-off, your timetable, notes, flashcards, logbook, tutor and Focus sessions.

Your plan
Planet

What happens next

  1. Create your accountYour email, a password and your date of birth.
  2. Add your subjectsEach one becomes a planet, set up for how that subject is examined.
  3. Upload your syllabusPlaeta lists the topics so you can tick them off.
  4. Add your study materialsUpload a past paper with its solutions, or your notes. Then answer a question and see your first marked response.
Open Plaeta →

Plaeta is in a free test phase. Accounts and payments open at launch, so nothing is charged today. During testing, Plaeta is for testers aged 18 and over. Varda, the AI, is ready to use, so there is nothing to set up.

A study partner for high school. Made in Australia.
